instruction: Convert the open web pages in Chrome to PDF and save them in /home/user/Downloads/Readings, using the title of each page as the PDF filename.

page_titles: How to Generate High Quality Human Data

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting 2 Chrome tabs to PDF files in /home/user/Downloads/Readings directory. The evaluator checks if 2 PDFs exist and their filenames contain substantial portions of the actual page titles ('LLM Powered Autonomous Agents' and 'How to Generate High Quality Human Data').

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: checks PDF count (2), directory location (/home/user/Downloads/Readings), and filename matching with page titles

Multi-word phrase matching logic is robust: requires at least 3 consecutive words (or 2 if title is short) from page titles to appear in filenames, preventing false positives like 'agent.pdf' or 'human.pdf'
Getter extracts correct state: lists PDF files in target directory using find command, returns basenames and file sizes for validation

Expected values are semantically correct: page titles match actual blog post titles from the URLs ('LLM Powered Autonomous Agents', 'How to Generate High Quality Human Data'), count=2 matches number of opened tabs
Partial credit scoring is well-designed: 80% weight on title matching, 20% on count, with granular scoring for too-few PDFs (30% partial credit) vs too-many PDFs (50% partial credit)
Logic handles filename variations: case-insensitive matching and normalization of hyphens/underscores to spaces for robust matching
File validity check: properly filters out empty PDFs by checking size > 0

Metric function correctly handles expected parameter: when expected.type='rule', it directly accesses expected.get('page_titles') and expected.get('count') which is correct since framework passes rules dict directly (no Section 5.1 violation)
No postconfig needed: verification reads saved PDF files from filesystem, not UI state, so closed print dialogs are not an issue
Complete coverage: all aspects of the instruction are verified (location, count, title-based naming)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add file creation timestamp check to ensure PDFs were created during task execution rather than pre-existing files (low priority since environment should start clean)
